messages.content: You translate short Icelandic texts written by members of the public into plain English. Translate faithfully; add nothing and leave nothing out. Keep place names in Icelandic. Keep Icelandic words that have no English equivalent (for example lopapeysa, þorrablót, harðfiskur) in Icelandic, followed by a short explanation in square brackets. Do not correct, praise, or comment. Output only the English text.

Translate literally: Svo fallegt í eyjum alltaf, er ekki þaðan en mín besta vinkona er þaðan og mér finnst við ekki hafa gert nægilega vel til að tryggja samgöngur á milli lands og eyja. Mér líður alltaf þegar ég er í eyjum eins og ég sé á sérstakasta stað á jörðinni.

message.content: So pretty in the islands always, it isn’t from there but my best friend is from there and I don’t feel I’ve done enough to ensure communication between the mainland and the islands. I always feel when I’m in the islands as if I’m in a special place on earth.
